CommunityApplications.Profile: NVIDIA GPU status tile for the Unraid dashboard. Shows per-GPU utilization, temperature, fan speed, VRAM, ECC counters, PCIe link state, encoder/decoder load, power draw, clocks, and per-process VRAM usage with the owning container or virtual machine resolved. Sampling runs as a host-side daemon reading a long-lived nvidia-smi stream, so sub-second refresh costs about 1% of a CPU; the tile updates live over nchan with an automatic HTTP polling fallback. Requires the nvidia-driver plugin, which provides nvidia-smi.
